A '''laser plow''' was a piece of [[Farm/Legends|farming]] equipment. [[Arn Stonelaw|Arn]] and [[Emmi Stonelaw]] owned a laser plow on [[Vernet]]. The Stonelaws required a calibrator for the equipment, and had requested that [[Mair Koda]] find one for them during her trading runs around the [[Zuni cluster]].<ref name="TD">{{JournalCite|15|The Draw}}</ref>
